camel_example: aliyun r-kvstore DescribeActiveOperationTasks --region cn-hangzhou --Status 3 --AllowCancel 1 --PageSize 25 --PageNumber 1 --AllowChange='-1' --TaskType rds_apsradb_transfer --Region 'cn-shanghai' --ProductId Redis --InsName 'r-wz96fzmpvpr2qnqnlb' --DbType redis --ChangeLevel all
description_en: Queries the details of O&M events for an instance
description_zh: 查询实例的运维事件详情
kebab_example: aliyun r-kvstore describe-active-operation-tasks --biz-region cn-shanghai --task-type rds_apsradb_transfer --page-size 25 --page-number 1 --product-id Redis --db-type redis --status 3 --ins-name r-wz96fzmpvpr2qnqnlb --allow-change='-1' --allow-cancel 1 --change-level all --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeActiveOperationTasks

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the pending events. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473763.html operation to query the region ID.
A value of all specifies all region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
待处理事件所属的地域ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473763.html接口获取。
取值为all表示所有地域ID
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en: The O&M event type. If this parameter is left empty, all event types are queried
parameters.help_zh: 运维事件类型，如果为空则查询所有类型
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 25. Maximum value: 100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be greater than 0. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The product name. Valid values: RDS, POLARDB, MongoDB, and Redis. For Redis instances, you can set this parameter to Redis
parameters.help_zh: 产品名称, RDS/POLARDB/MongoDB/Redis，对于 Redis 实例可选 Redis
parameters.name: product_id

parameters.help_en: The database engine type. Set the value to redis
parameters.name: db_type

parameters.help_en:
The status of the O&M event, which is used to filter the returned tasks. Valid values:
-1: all events
3: pending
4: in progress
5: succeeded
6: failed
7: canceled
parameters.help_zh:
运维事件状态，用于筛选返回任务，取值：
-1：全部事件。
3：待处理事件。
4：处理中事件。
5：成功结束事件。
6：失败结束事件。
7：已取消事件
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The instance name. This parameter is optional. If you specify this parameter, you can specify only one instance name
parameters.help_zh: 实例名，可不填，填写时只允许填写至多一个实例名
parameters.name: ins_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the execution time can be modified. Default value: -1. Valid values:

-1: all events
0: Only O&M events whose execution time cannot be modified are returned.
1: Only O&M events whose execution time can be modified are returned
parameters.help_zh:
是否允许修改时间，默认-1，取值：

-1：全部。
0：只返回不允许修改时间的运维事件。
1：只返回允许修改时间的运维事件
parameters.name: allow_change

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the event can be canceled. Default value: -1. Valid values:

-1: all events
0: Only O&M events that cannot be canceled are returned.
1: Only O&M events that can be canceled are returned
parameters.help_zh:
是否允许取消，默认-1，取值：

-1：全部。
0：只返回不允许取消的运维事件。
1：只返回允许取消的运维事件
parameters.name: allow_cancel

parameters.help_en:
The change level. Default value: all. Valid values:

all: all exception repair and system O&M levels
S0: exception repair
S1: system O&M
parameters.help_zh:
变更级别，默认all：

all：选择全部异常修复和系统运维的级别
S0：异常修复
S1：系统运维
parameters.name: change_level

items.description_en: The details of the O&M event

AllowCancel.description_en: Indicates whether the event can be canceled. A value of 1 indicates that users are allowed to cancel the event. A value of 0 indicates that users are not allowed to cancel the event
AllowCancel.description_zh: 是否允许取消，1 表示允许用户取消事件，0 表示不允许取消

AllowChange.description_en: Indicates whether the execution time can be modified. A value of 1 indicates that users are allowed to modify the execution time. A value of 0 indicates that users are not allowed to modify the execution time
AllowChange.description_zh: 是否允许修改时间，1 表示允许用户修改时间，0 表示不允许用户修改时间

ChangeLevel.description_en: The event level code. S1 indicates system O&M, and S0 indicates exception repair
ChangeLevel.description_zh: 事件等级代码，S1 系统运维 S0 风险修复

CreatedTime.description_en: The time when the event was created. The time is displayed in UTC in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format
CreatedTime.description_zh: 创建时间，为 UTC 时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ

DbType.description_en: The database engine type. Valid value: redis

Deadline.description_en: The latest time within the adjustable range for the task execution time. The time is displayed in UTC in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format
Deadline.description_zh: 任务执行时间可调整范围的最晚期限，为 UTC 时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ

ModifiedTime.description_en: The time when the event was modified. The time is displayed in UTC in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format
ModifiedTime.description_zh: 修改时间，为 UTC 时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ

PrepareInterval.description_en: The preparation time required between the start time and the switchover time. The time is in the HH:mm:ss format
PrepareInterval.description_zh: 开始时间到切换时间之间所需的准备时间, 格式为 HH:mm:ss

StartTime.description_en: The time when the backend executes the event. The time is displayed in UTC in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format
StartTime.description_zh: 后台执行事件的时间点，为 UTC 时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ

Status.description_en:
The status of the O&M event. Valid values:
3: pending
4: in progress
5: succeeded
6: failed
7: canceled
Status.description_zh:
运维事件状态，返回值：
3：待处理事件。
4：处理中事件。
5：成功结束事件。
6：失败结束事件。
7：已取消事件

SwitchTime.description_en: The time when the backend initiated the switchover operation. The time is displayed in UTC in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format
SwitchTime.description_zh: 后台发起切换操作的时间点，为 UTC 时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ

TaskTypeEn.description_en: The cause of the O&M event in English
TaskTypeEn.description_zh: 产生运维事件原因英文

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 25

TotalRecordCount.description_en: The total number of returned O&M event records
